latin: Ipse revelat profunda et abscondita, et novit in tenebris constituta, et lux cum eo est.
english: It is he that revealeth deep and hidden things, and knoweth what is in darkness: and light is with him.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Tunc Danieli mysterium per visionem nocte revelatum est: et benedixit Daniel Deum caeli.
english: Then was the mystery revealed to Daniel by a vision in the night: and Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Multi autem ex eis, qui fuerant curiosa sectati, contulerunt libros, et combusserunt coram omnibus: et computatis pretiis illorum, invenerunt pecuniam denariorum quinquaginta millium.
english: And many of them who had followed curious arts, brought together their books, and burnt them before all; and counting the price of them, they found the money to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Gloria Dei est celare verbum, et gloria regum investigare sermonem.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal the word, and the glory of kings to search out the speech.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Ecce sapientior es tu Daniele: omne secretum non est absconditum a te.
english: Behold thou art wiser than Daniel: no secret is hid from thee.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Et facto mane, pavore perterritus, misit ad omnes coniectores Aegypti, cunctosque sapientes: et accersitis narravit somnium, nec erat qui interpretaretur.
english: And when morning was come, being struck with fear, he sent to all the interpreters of Egypt, and to all the wise men: and they being called for, he told them his dream, and there was not any one that could interpret it.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Forsitan vestigia Dei comprehendes, et usque ad perfectum Omnipotentem reperies?
english: Peradventure thou wilt comprehend the steps of God, and wilt find out the Almighty perfectly?

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Ipse enim dedit mihi horum, quae sunt, scientiam veram: ut sciam dispositionem orbis terrarum, et virtutes elementorum.
english: For he hath given me the true knowledge of the things that are: to know the disposition of the whole world, and the virtues of the elements.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Vocavit autem Pharao sapientes et maleficos: et fecerunt etiam ipsi per incantationes Aegyptiacas et arcana quaedam similiter.
english: And Pharao called the wise men and the magicians: and they also by Egyptian enchantments and certain secrets did in like manner.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Nec inveniatur in te qui lustret filium suum, aut filiam, ducens per ignem: aut qui ariolos sciscitetur, et observet somnia atque auguria, nec sit maleficus, nec incantator, nec qui pythones consulat, nec divinos, aut quaerat a mortuis veritatem.
english: Neither let there be found among you any one that shall expiate his son or daughter, making them to pass through the fire: or that consulteth soothsayers, or observeth dreams and omens, neither let there be any wizard, nor charmer, nor any one that consulteth pythonic spirits, or fortune tellers, or that seeketh the truth from the dead.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible
